conhecido como camarão da Amazônia ou regional pos-

desde a Venezuela até o estado do Paraná, habitando

no município do Crato-CE. Este possui valor econô-

capturado através de pesca artesanal. Estudos relacio-

constituindo os urópodes.

tâmeros embrionários, sendo que o primeiro e o segundo
metâmero apresentam, cada um, um par de antenas que
desempenham funções de equilíbrio, tato e paladar.
C) O tórax do camarão é formado pela fusão de oito metâ-
meros embrionários sendo que os últimos cinco metâmero
apresentam um par de pereiópodes, adaptados para cami-
nhar nos fundos submersos.

minhar.

Texto II - Questões 48 a 51.
Artificial Intelligence is everywhere, but where is it, actually?
Most Artificial Intelligence (AI) that people encounter are rather
shy; they tend to be working under the layer.
Among thousands of
topics available to choose from, have you ever wondered why content
displayed on the Instagram explore page or YouTube homepage can
match your interests? Both Instagram and YouTube use AI to create
personalized content for their users so that the contents are relevant to
their likes. Recently liked a post about food? Instagram will recommend
you more posts about food, which will probably be different from your
friend, whose recent liked posts are about football.
Other applications of AI that many people (from a consumer pers-
pective) may not notice are in marketing. Effective advertisements are
those that land on the right audience. In order to achieve this, AI analy-
zes users’ data, then determines which ads will suit best for you based
on your interests. If you happen to buy a product from an ad that was
shown on your social media, then the algorithm is definitely doing a
great job. Amazon utilizes AI to predict the context of use from custo-
mer queries. Hence, customers will be provided with a more relevant
search result.
Some more popular fields of AI - because they can actively inte-
ract with you - are computer vision and speech recognition. Specialized
tasks of computer vision including object and face detection are used in
autonomous vehicles and Apple’s Face ID. Virtual assistants such as Siri
and Google Assistant utilizes speech recognition in their system.

conscious. The Sophia robot is one example of how AI is becoming
more sophisticated and human-like, raising questions about the nature
of AI and its potential impact on humanity.

after an AI-powered educational robot, designed to teach children to
play chess, grabbed his hand and wouldn’t let go.
This incident highlights the risk of physical harm posed by AI-
powered devices, especially when they are not designed or programmed
properly. But the question of whether AI can think or become conscious
is a complex one. While current AI technology is not truly “thinking”
or “conscious” in the same way that humans are, some experts believe
that there is a possibility that AI could eventually reach a point where
it is self-aware and able to make decisions based on its own desires and
goals, rather than simply following pre-programmed rules.
If AI can achieve consciousness, this could be the time when it takes
over 100% of humans. This raises serious ethical concerns about the po-
